name: Marie Christmas - Vogue Night
description: Malaghetto and Pump The Beat throw a Christmas vogue night party at Pérola Negra, from 23:59 on Friday 11 December until 06:00.
longDescription:
Marie Christmas is a Vogue Night party at Pérola Negra, organised by Malaghetto together with Pump The Beat. The music runs through electro, funk and afro sounds.

The party starts at 23:59 on Friday 11 December 2026 and goes on until 06:00, at Pérola Negra, Rua de Gonçalo Cristóvão 284, Porto.

The current "lote no escuro" (blind batch) tickets cost €6.00 on Shotgun and can be resold in the app if plans change.
